name: video-text
title: Video Text
description: Renders a short word as a mask over a looping video, so the footage appears only inside the letterforms while the space between them stays empty.
use: One short word should carry a video texture and dominate a hero without a separate image block.
avoid: Long sentences or small type, where the mask turns muddy, and anywhere autoplay video is blocked.
a11y: A hidden text copy names the word for assistive tech, but the looping video has no pause and ignores reduced motion. (keyboard: n-a, labels: good, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: The single word OCEAN in very heavy, wide capitals spans a band across a black stage. The letters are not painted but act as windows onto moving teal water, with coral and light patches drifting inside the thick strokes.
behaves: The clip loops behind the word and shows only through the letters, so colour and texture inside each stroke keep changing while the gaps and the background stay black. The word scales with the viewport and stays centred.
customise: Pass the word as children and the clip as src; font size, weight, family, anchor, autoplay, mute, loop and preload are props.
weight: light: One looping video element and a CSS SVG mask, with no scripted animation loop.
